beats.say: One of these incredibly beautiful but tricky concepts goes by the name partial evaluation.
If you are fascinated by interpreters and compilers, partial evaluation will teach you how they are related, and how you can get a compiler for free.

Partial evaluation has been a fascination of mine for a while. The essay starts with simple examples and builds up to the three Futamura projections: partially evaluating an interpreter with a program gives a compiled program.
